title: Analysis of Indic Language Capabilities in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Aggregating and comparing LLM performance on Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and Natural Language Generation (NLG) tasks across twelve Indic languages to highlight performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages, as well as between Indic languages and English.

Reviewing model performance on culturally-specific benchmark datasets (such as MILU and PARIKSHA) that test LLM comprehension of culturally nuanced scenarios, local history, arts, and festivals to identify gaps in cultural understanding.
